scaling: For each fit, compute c = norm(gradient_parity(theta0)) / norm(gradient_objective(theta0)) from training observations and the common sampled masks. Hold c fixed for all 600 updates; parity c=1. Zero or nonfinite initial norms fail explicitly.
selection: For each objective choose the learning rate with minimum mean validation NLL over all ten development seeds. Each objective receives the same six learning rates and 600 updates per candidate. Break exact ties by configuration key; never select by exact target KL. Sigma .75 and ring3 architecture are inherited from prior work, not newly searched.
historical_scope: Reimplementation of the attached exploratory 20-seed analysis; not independent confirmation. Original non-NLL learning rates are incompletely specified; use common lr .1 and report both stated NLL rates .1 and .2. Original code and unrounded artifacts were unavailable.
confirmation_scope: Freeze all seven selected configurations, source/protocol hashes and the 120 new seeds before any confirmation fits. Evaluate every final iterate once. No retuning, stopping based on results, seed removal/replacement or per-seed selection.
inference: Exact unfloored forward KL. Two-sided paired Student-t intervals: nominal 95% and Bonferroni 95% family coverage for 11 comparisons (parity vs six alternatives, MSE vs five other standard objectives). Failed or nonfinite pairs invalidate the relevant interval; no omissions. Mean rank is descriptive and does not prove general loss superiority.
claim_scope: Fixed n=12, beta=.9, m=200, 36-parameter IQP circuit and 600-update budget. Tests objective choice and initial gradient scaling. Does not establish causal representation alignment, universal optimality, quantum speedup, or superiority over support-aware classical models.
seed_note: 710001-710120 do not occur in checked repository protocols or result tables. Derived data 710008-710127, masks 710223-710342, initialization 723585-723704, validation 760001-760120 do not overlap the documented prior cohorts.
